'''Telex-Delcor''', also known as '''Talex-Delcor'''<ref name="SG" /> was a small manufacturer of space skiffs, starship security systems, and riot suppression weapons.

==Products==
*[[SS-39 Space Skiff]]
*[[SS-39L space skiff]]
*[[SWE/2 sonic riot suppression gun]]
*[[Tranq 25 HV Pistol]]
